newsitem.title: USA: IADB to lend Latam microenterprises $500 mln.
newsitem.headline: IADB to lend Latam microenterprises $500 mln.

text.p: The Inter-American Development Bank said Tuesday it would lend $500 million over five years to microenterprises in Latin America and the Caribbean.

A statement quoted IADB President Enrique Iglesias as saying the money would be invested in the form of grants, loans, guarantees and equity investments to help an estimated 150 million people in the region who make their living as small-scale manufacturers, craftspeople, sidewalk vendors, service providers and small farmers.

"We know that by democratizing and expanding access to credit, savings facilities and other kinds of support, we can dramatically improve opportunities and the future of poor people in our hemisphere and the world," Iglesias told microcredit talks in Washington.
